title: Credit cards
subtitle: What is on each card, and when the bank is charged for it.
emptyBody: Add a card with its billing day, and purchases on it count on the day the bank is charged.
expired: This card has expired. Add the new one, or update its expiry.
expiresSoon: This card expires soon: the new one should be on its way.
noBillingDay: No billing day yet. Set one, and this card's purchases will count on the day the bank is charged.
limitLeft: <left></left> left to use. Instalments count in full until they are paid.

edit.expiresHint: As printed on the card, month and year. The card number and the code on the back are never asked for.
edit.expiresInvalid: Use the month and year on the card, like 09/28.
edit.billingDayHint: The day the bank pays the card each month. A month's purchases are charged together on this day of the next month.
edit.billingDayInvalid: A day of the month, 1 to 31.
edit.fxFeeHint: Added to every purchase in a currency other than the shekel.
edit.creditRateHint: Filled in for you on a credit plan charged to this card.
edit.lateRateHint: Charged if a bill is not paid on time.
edit.rateInvalid: Enter a rate, like 1.5 (or -0.5 below prime).
edit.monthlyFeeHint: Leave empty if the card has no fee. Charged on the card each month from now on.
edit.discountHint: 100% waives the fee. Usually for a year from when the card was issued; leave Until empty if it has no end.

discountEarned: Spent <spent></spent> of <target></target>: <percent></percent> off the fee this month.
discountToGo: Spent <spent></spent> of <target></target> for <percent></percent> off the fee.
discountNoEnd: The discount has no end date.
